name: Downloads cleanup agent
description: Scans your Downloads folder for stale, duplicate and oversized files and proposes a cleanup. Always previews the exact file list first (dry run) and only deletes after you approve.
approvalPrompt: FRIDAY wants to DELETE {count} file(s) ({size}) from “{folder}” that are older than {olderThanDays} days or duplicated. This is permanent — files go to the recycle bin only if your system does that by default. Review the previewed list before allowing.
